good: Strong watch retention at 7.0s avg—narrative arc (decision → announcement → celebration) keeps viewers engaged through the full clip

Clear production and professional branding (UFC overlays, athlete focus) builds credibility and authority
Victory celebration offers natural emotional payoff with flag moment—fans recognize the athlete and context
bad: Weak hook—starts with post-celebration rather than in-fight drama; decisions lack the visceral scroll-stop power of knockouts or dramatic exchanges
Minimal save rate (0.07%)—content isn't memorable or shareable enough; no "clip this" moment drives bookmarking
No engagement CTA—missing prompts to tag friends, predict outcomes, or follow for more fights
Plain text framing ('vence por decisão') is factual but emotionally flat; no 'upset,' 'masterclass,' or 'undefeated' hook to amplify shareability
reels.top_tip: Lead with the most dramatic in-fight moment (intense strike exchange or decision buildup reaction) instead of post-fight celebration—decisions need visual tension in the hook to compete with knockout clips in the feed
